title: Career source census closed by disposition, while outcome mapping remains blocked
research_question: What does Career's structured-ID closure establish, and which source/semantic/compiler blockers remain after deep review?
before_state: Large Career rule inventories risked being described as complete solely because every source rule had a structured ID or every blocked row had been reviewed.
result: The accepted main backlog records 888/888 unique structured IDs with dispositions, but 513 BLOCKED_OUTCOME_MAPPING records remain in the strict-review census. Separately, the 251-row contextual-activation closure records a non-overlapping deep-source review of 228/228 blocked rows; its latest census has 26 row-local candidates, only 12 Knowledge condition-IR-ready, 14 still not condition-IR-ready, conditions_compiled=0 and execution_unlocked=0.
key_insights: 888/888 is an ID-disposition closure, not 888 executable judgments.

The 513 outcome-mapping blockers belong to the 888-rule Career census; the 228/228 deep-source-review statistic belongs to the separate 251-row contextual-activation closure. These denominators must not be merged.
The 251-row closure preserves source underdetermination and fail-closed behavior instead of inventing group quantifiers, generic meeting geometry or compound composition.
The 26 row-local candidates split into 12 Knowledge condition-IR-ready and 14 not condition-IR-ready; no Product condition compilation or execution unlock is claimed.
negative_findings: Deep-source review does not by itself remove a semantic blocker.
Source closure and structured representation do not prove Product runtime executability.
The accepted artifacts report conditions_compiled=0 and execution_unlocked=0.
unexpected_findings: 251 of the 513 outcome-mapping blockers directly touch group/quantifier semantics when the backlog's non-mutually-exclusive group intersections are counted; this points to source-scoped group/quantifier treatment as a high-impact ontology dependency, not permission to add global defaults.

boundaries.source_status: Explicit in accepted Knowledge artifacts at the recorded main checkpoint.
boundaries.implementation_status: Structured dispositions and selected condition-IR records exist; Product compilation and execution unlock remain zero in the cited readiness artifacts.
boundaries.internal_fidelity: The records include deterministic census and validation contracts; this event does not rerun their test suites.

authority_notes: This event deliberately preserves two different denominators (888 Career canonical IDs and 251 contextual-activation records). Do not imply that the 228 deep-reviewed rows are the same set as the 513 outcome-mapping blockers. No Knowledge files were modified by this Sidecar work.
